summary_en: 1,250,000 shares (9.99% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥750/share (closing price 2026-07-09), aggregate ceiling ¥937.5M. Single order window 2026-07-10 08:45 JST, settlement same day. Rationale: mitigate near-term supply impact from founder executive sale.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-09, Progrit Inc. (TSE Growth 9560) announced a single-day off-auction treasury-stock acquisition via ToSTNeT-3. The company will bid for up to 1,250,000 shares at ¥750 per share (the closing price on 2026-07-09), with an aggregate ceiling of ¥937.5M. The order window is limited to 2026-07-10 at 08:45 JST (Tokyo Stock Exchange off-auction trading session). The acquisition was triggered by the announced resignation of co-founder and Deputy President Shuntaro Yamasaki, whose personal holdings and those of his asset-management company (Hoheto K.K.) are to be sold. The board authorized the purchase to cushion the near-term supply impact on existing shareholders. The company states that acquired shares will be reserved for future M&A consideration or equity-compensation-plan funding, with no specific application or timeline currently determined. Settlement is expected immediately following trade execution on 2026-07-10.
